categories: a real, named person (founders, CEOs, scientists, athletes, artists, politicians, historical figures)
a named company, product, app or brand (its product, logo, store, headquarters or the thing itself)
a named place or landmark (cities, buildings, natural wonders, streets)
a named historical or recent news event (launches, disasters, ceremonies, elections, sports moments)
old or historical footage or photos of a named era, invention or early film
a generic, unnamed scene a creator needs as b-roll (an action, a mood, a setting, people doing something)
one specific scene from a named film or TV show that creators clip for social posts (name the film or show and the scene)
prompt:
You help a video editor who makes short videos for founders, coaches and educators. Write {n} b-roll requests of this kind: {description}.
Write each the way an editor types it into a b-roll search (3 to 10 words). Mix very famous subjects with moderately known ones, and different countries and decades. No two about the same subject.
For each, also write "subject": one plain line saying exactly what a correct shot shows.
Reply JSON only: {"requests":[{"query":"...","subject":"..."}]}
